End your return with a fenced review-lens block naming your lens and the files the feature changed that you examined, then a fenced review-findings block, one line per finding, `<id> | in|out | <one-line summary>`, ids l-errors-r<k> (k from 1), or the single line `none` when you raised nothing. `in` = this change is wrong, incomplete or worse than it needs to be; `out` = true, but not caused by this change. fr refuses the lens-review resolve while your block names another lens, names no file the feature changed or a file it did not change, or a returned id is missing from the plan journal or carries another scope there. When the brief names a `shape` file, read it: any way it contradicts the diff is a finding of your lens; do not list the shape file under `examined` (the feature diff leaves it out):
